written_before: any OmniSim run of a world other than nominal

predictions.claim: In the nominal OmniSim world the expert scores at least 0.95 and the mean of the five OmniSim-trained clones at least 0.90.
At friction_0.07 in OmniSim the expert scores below 0.50.
At friction_0.07 in OmniSim the mean clone scores above the expert.
mass_x10 moves neither the expert nor the mean clone by more than 0.05 from nominal in OmniSim.

The friction cliff (the step from expert >= 0.90 to expert <= 0.10) lies between 0.08 and 0.06 in OmniSim too. Weakest of the five: the scenes share the MuJoCo solver but not the contact softness, which OmniSim sets per world rather than per geom.
